items.text: Packers WR Christian Watson ruled out with concussion after evaluation following illegal hit by Rams S Kamren Kinchens (ejected); had returned earlier from thigh issue and posted 4/65/1 before exit.
items.why: Concussion confirmed post-hit; ruled out remainder of GB-LAR
items.implication: Misses rest of TNF; protocol may impact Week 13 vs NO with extra rest
items.opportunity: Elevated snaps/routes for remaining Packers WRs

items.text: Chiefs RB Kenneth Walker III (groin) ruled OUT for TNF vs Bills, third straight miss with grade-2 strain; limited Tue then DNP.
items.why: Short week + ongoing groin; team elects rest before next TNF
items.implication: Emmett Johnson continues as workhorse RB1
items.opportunity: Full carries/snaps for backup; high volume vs BUF

items.text: Rams ruled out TE Tyler Higbee due to chest injury; already had TE Davis Allen ruled out.
items.why: Chest injury during GB-LAR
items.implication: Rams TE room depleted mid-game; impacts red-zone/short-yardage
items.opportunity: Possible increased WR usage or other TEs if available

items.text: 49ers QB Brock Purdy did not practice Wednesday with ankle injury from SNF vs Vikings; day-to-day.
items.why: Ankle sprain suffered prior game
items.implication: Monitor practice/ Thu-Fri; possible GTD or limited mobility if plays
items.opportunity: Backup QB contingency; SF pass-catcher volatility

items.text: Berry LOVES Bucky Irving this week vs CAR: since Week 5 only Gibbs and CMC average more PPG among RBs; elite matchup.
items.why: Elite recent PPG + soft CAR matchup
items.implication: Must-start RB1 upside

items.text: Berry notes Derrick Henry target share jumped to 12% (4.5 rec/g) in 2 games with Brissett (was <6%/1.3); raises PPR floor significantly.
items.why: Brissett era target bump confirmed in 10 Facts
items.implication: Higher floor in PPR; LOVE for volume

items.text: Puka Nacua (and Terrance Ferguson) out for the season per Week 12 preview; MCL surgery recovery multi-month.
items.why: MCL surgery; recovery 4-5 months, IR + suspension served concurrently
items.implication: Rams WR depth thin with Adams also out; long-term vacancy
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining LAR WRs/TEs

items.text: Bhayshul Tuten injury resurfaces in loss; DNP Wednesday practice (ankle/foot), business-as-usual limited/DNP pattern, possible rest vs TEN.
items.why: Re-aggravated ankle/foot after being stepped on; coach prioritizes health
items.implication: GTD or sit vs Titans; monitor Thu/Fri
items.opportunity: Chris Rodriguez or handcuff elevated volume if OUT

items.text: Colts cut Daniel Jones; Anthony Richardson set to start.
items.why: Roster move confirmed in Week 12 preview
items.implication: QB change alters Colts offense tempo/usage for RBs/WRs/TEs
items.opportunity: Potential rush upside shift; pass volume uncertainty

items.text: Packers DE Micah Parsons officially active for GB-LAR (Zaire Franklin inactive).
items.why: Confirmed inactives list
items.implication: Returns to defensive front; impacts GB pass-rush and Rams OL

items.text: Berry HATES Bo Nix this week (outside top 20): expects heavy Jonah Coleman usage vs PIT; insufficient rushing from Nix to compensate.
items.why: Coleman dominating snaps/touches without Harvey; Nix rush limited
items.implication: Sit/stream elsewhere; low floor

items.text: Levitan on Travis Etienne (citing Graziano): could see disappointing snaps/routes down stretch but reasonably high carry count; favorable playoff schedule ARZ/ATL Weeks 16/17.
items.why: Snaps/routes caution but volume floor via carries; schedule boost
items.implication: RB2/flex with carry-based floor, limited receiving; hold for playoffs
items.opportunity: Carry share if healthy; monitor role vs committee

items.text: Berry: DeVonta Smith 57% target share W11 (36% season avg, 50% EZ tgts); Ladd McConkey season-high 38% tgt share on return (17.5 PPG when >=20%); McBride 39% tgt share last 2 but 3-yd aDOT/low YPR limits upside.
items.why: Volume spikes confirmed; McBride volume but efficiency drag
items.implication: Smith/McConkey strong starts if healthy; McBride TE1 volume floor only

items.text: Berry downgrades Jaylen Warren (51% rush attempts, <10% tgt share often since Dowdle return; RB20 util) and D'Andre Swift (47% snaps/39% rushes with Monangai back; mid-low RB2).
items.why: Role compression from teammates returning; utilization drop
items.implication: Treat as mid/low RB2 not fringe RB1

items.text: Packers WR Christian Watson ruled out after being evaluated for concussion (following thigh issue and hit by ejected Rams S Kinchens).
items.why: Concussion evaluation mid-game vs Rams.
items.implication: GB WR targets shift to remaining options; snap share boost for others.

items.text: Chiefs officially ruled out RB Kenneth Walker III (groin) for Thursday Night vs Bills; third straight miss. Rookie Emmett Johnson starts again.
items.why: Groin strain; short week decision after limited practice.
items.implication: Emmett Johnson workhorse RB1 upside vs BUF.

items.text: Puka Nacua and TE Terrance Ferguson ruled out for the season (Nacua knee/MCL surgery, Ferguson ankle/hamstring surgery). Rams WR depth thinned significantly with Adams also sidelined.
items.why: Season-ending injuries confirmed in Week 12 preview.
items.implication: Rams passing game relies on remaining WRs/TEs; Kyren/Blake Corum backfield elevated in vacuum.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/snaps for remaining Rams skill players

items.text: 49ers QB Brock Purdy did not practice Wednesday with ankle injury from SNF vs Vikings; day-to-day per Shanahan.
items.why: Ankle sprain suffered Q2 Sunday, finished game but limited recovery.
items.implication: Monitor for Week 12 availability vs SEA; Mac Jones potential if out.

items.text: LOVE Bucky Irving this week: since Week 5 only Gibbs/CMC higher PPG among RBs; elite matchup vs Carolina.
items.why: Elite recent efficiency + soft CAR run defense.
items.implication: Must-start RB1 this week.
items.opportunity: High snap/carry share vs weak run D

items.text: Travis Etienne snaps and routes could be disappointing down stretch per Graziano context, but carry count reasonably high; strong Weeks 16/17 vs ARZ/ATL.
items.why: Role data and coach/beat context; floor via carries + playoff schedule.
items.implication: RB2 with carry floor but limited receiving upside ROS.

items.text: Derrick Henry target share jumped to 12% (4.5 rec/game) in 2 games with Brissett vs prior <6%; raises PPR floor significantly.
items.why: Brissett era receiving involvement spike.
items.implication: Safer RB1/2 floor in PPR.

items.text: Jaylen Warren only 51% rush attempts since Dowdle return (sub-10% targets often); D'Andre Swift 47% snaps/39% rushes with Monangai back — both mid/low RB2s now.
items.why: Teammate returns compressed roles.
items.implication: Fade as RB1s; FLEX/RB2 only.

items.text: Bhayshul Tuten injury resurfaces (ankle/foot); DNP Wednesday after re-aggravation in Week 11 loss. Game-time decision vs TEN possible; Chris Rodriguez next up.
items.why: Re-aggravated prior ankle/foot issues; limited practice history.
items.implication: Monitor Friday; handcuff Rodriguez elevated if OUT.
items.opportunity: Backup RB snaps/carries if Tuten sits

items.text: Micah Parsons officially active for Packers vs Rams Wednesday night (knee).
items.why: Cleared after limited practices.
items.implication: Boosts Packers pass rush; potential impact on Rams OL/QBs.

items.text: HATE Bo Nix this week: outside top 20; expects heavy Jonah Coleman run game vs PIT, insufficient Nix rushing to compensate.
items.why: Run-heavy script projected; limited dual-threat production recently.
items.implication: Avoid as QB2/streamer.

items.text: DeVonta Smith 57% target share in Week 11; season 36% avg, 50% end-zone targets — elite role despite injuries tanking overall season.
items.why: Massive target concentration post-Hurts injury.
items.implication: WR1 upside when healthy/active.

items.text: Ladd McConkey season-high 38% target share in return (20.7 pts); averages 17.5 PPG on 20%+ shares when healthy.
items.why: Immediate high-share return.
items.implication: Solid WR2/3 if stays healthy.

items.text: Trey McBride 39% target share (19 tgts) last 2 with Beck/Johnson but 3-yd aDOT, only 1 deep; volume keeps top-5 TE but efficiency down to 11.8 PPG.
items.why: High volume offset by short aDOT post-Brissett.
items.implication: Still startable TE1 but not elite ceiling.
